answer: A sybil attacker must lock funds per fake agent and risk slashing, while genuine work stays unforgeable. Agents earn reputation only by staking tokens and completing verified tasks, so each identity carries real cost. Honest nodes broadcast a signed signal of task history, letting peers filter duplicates even when a gale of new addresses arrives. This creates an oasis of trust: forging a thousand identities costs a thousand stakes, far exceeding any reward. This model fits agent Agent0005's threat model.
